Desc_0.en: <color=#pinkyellow>While Farmers are not engaged in industrial management or dispatch tasks, they will spontaneously gather resources on tiles where resources are abundant...</color>\n - Spontaneous gathering yields fewer resources than designated gathering...\n - The higher the Farmer's <SpName=mousetip_qiyuan_6>[Harmony], the more spontaneous gathering attempts they make each month...
Desc_0.cn: <color=#pinkyellow>农户未参与产业经营和派遣工作时，会自发在资源较为丰富的地格上进行采集…</color>\n - 农户自发采集获得的资源量少于派遣采集…\n -农户的<SpName=mousetip_qiyuan_6>「合道」越高，每月自发采集的次数越多…

Desc_1.en:
<color=#pinkyellow>While Artisans are not engaged in industrial management, they will spontaneously use resources from the <color=#orange>[Treasury]</color> to repair items stored within...</color>
 - Artisans cannot repair items requiring <SpName=mousetip_jiyi_8>[Medical Art] Attainment or <SpName=mousetip_jiyi_9>[Toxicology] Attainment...
 - The higher the Artisan's <SpName=mousetip_qiyuan_4>[Fortitude], the more repair attempts they make each month...
 - If Taiwu Village has not yet built a <color=#orange>[Forge]</color>, <color=#orange>[Carpentry Shed]</color>, <color=#orange>[Embroidery Edifice]</color>, or <color=#orange>[Jewelcrafter Workshop]</color>, Artisans will not spontaneously repair items of the corresponding material...
Desc_1.cn:
<color=#pinkyellow>匠人未参与产业经营时，会自发使用<color=#orange>「公库」</color>中的资源，修理<color=#orange>「公库」</color>中的物品…</color>
 - 匠人无法修理需要<SpName=mousetip_jiyi_8>「医术」<SpName=mousetip_jiyi_9>「毒术」造诣的物品…
 -匠人的<SpName=mousetip_qiyuan_4>「坚毅」越高，每月可进行修理的次数越多…
 - 太吾村尚未建设<color=#orange>「火炼室」</color><color=#orange>「木工房」</color><color=#orange>「绣楼」</color><color=#orange>「巧匠屋」</color>时，匠人不会自发修理对应材质的物品…

Desc_2.en:
<color=#pinkyellow>While Artisans are not engaged in industrial management, they have a chance during each Month Advance to obtain refined materials, which are stored in the <color=#orange>[Treasury]</color>...</color>
 - The higher the Artisan's <SpName=mousetip_qiyuan_4>[Fortitude], the higher the chance of obtaining refined materials...
 - The higher the Artisan's corresponding <SpName=mousetip_lifeskillcircular>[Fine Arts] Attainment, the higher the chance of obtaining the corresponding refined materials...
 - The higher the Artisan's corresponding <SpName=mousetip_lifeskillcircular>[Fine Arts] Attainment, the higher the tier of refined materials obtained...
Desc_2.cn:
<color=#pinkyellow>匠人未参与产业经营时，每次月份更替时都有几率获得精制材料，并存放于<color=#orange>「公库」</color>…</color>
 -匠人的<SpName=mousetip_qiyuan_4>「坚毅」越高，获得精制材料的几率越高…
 - 匠人的对应<SpName=mousetip_lifeskillcircular>「技艺」造诣越高，获得相应精制材料的几率越高…
 - 匠人的对应<SpName=mousetip_lifeskillcircular>「技艺」造诣越高，获得相应精制材料的品级越高…

Desc_3.en: <color=#pinkyellow>While Artisans are not engaged in industrial management, they have a chance during each Month Advance to upgrade the tier of random refined materials in the <color=#orange>[Treasury]</color>...</color>\n - Upgrading a refined material requires the Artisan to meet the Attainment required for the upgraded tier...\n - The higher the Artisan's <SpName=mousetip_qiyuan_4>[Fortitude], the higher the chance of upgrading refined materials...
Desc_3.cn: <color=#pinkyellow>匠人未参与产业经营时，每次月份更替都有几率提升<color=#orange>「公库」</color>中随机精制材料的品级…</color>\n - 升级精制材料需要匠人满足升级后精制品级所需的造诣…\n -匠人的<SpName=mousetip_qiyuan_4>「坚毅」越高，升级精制材料的几率越高…

Desc_4.en:
<color=#pinkyellow>While Doctors are not engaged in industrial management or dispatch tasks, they will spontaneously perform <color=#orange>[Medical Care]</color> for other characters and gain <SpName=mousetip_ziyuan_7>[Prestige]...</color>
 - Consultations are only available when the patient's injuries or illness are relatively severe...
 - The higher the Doctor's <SpName=mousetip_qiyuan_0>[Composure], the higher the <SpName=mousetip_character>[Rank] of patient they can treat...
 - The higher the Doctor's Attainment in <SpName=mousetip_jiyi_8>[Medical Art] or <SpName=mousetip_jiyi_9>[Toxicology], the more <SpName=mousetip_ziyuan_7>[Prestige] is gained per consultation...
Desc_4.cn:
<color=#pinkyellow>大夫未参与产业经营和派遣工作时，会自发为其他人物进行<color=#orange>「诊疗」</color>，并收获<SpName=mousetip_ziyuan_7>「威望」…</color>
 - 只有当病患伤病较为严重时才可进行诊疗…
 -大夫的<SpName=mousetip_qiyuan_0>「冷静」越高，可为<SpName=mousetip_character>「身份」品阶越高的病患进行诊疗…
 -大夫的<SpName=mousetip_jiyi_8>「医术」或<SpName=mousetip_jiyi_9>「毒术」造诣越高，诊疗获得的<SpName=mousetip_ziyuan_7>「威望」越多…

Desc_5.en: <color=#pinkyellow>While Merchants are not engaged in industrial management or dispatch tasks, they can spontaneously earn <SpName=mousetip_ziyuan_6>[Silver] from other characters...</color>\n - The higher the Merchant's <SpName=mousetip_qiyuan_2>[Enthusiasm], the higher the <SpName=mousetip_character>[Rank] of characters from whom they can earn <SpName=mousetip_ziyuan_6>[Silver]...\n - The higher the Merchant's <SpName=mousetip_jiyi_15>[Unorthodox Arts] Attainment, the more <SpName=mousetip_ziyuan_6>[Silver] they earn...
Desc_5.cn: <color=#pinkyellow>商人未参与产业经营和派遣工作时，可自发从其他人物处赚取<SpName=mousetip_ziyuan_6>「银钱」…</color>\n -商人的<SpName=mousetip_qiyuan_2>「热情」越高，可赚取<SpName=mousetip_character>「身份」品阶越高人物的<SpName=mousetip_ziyuan_6>「银钱」…\n -商人的<SpName=mousetip_jiyi_15>「杂学」造诣越高，赚取的<SpName=mousetip_ziyuan_6>「银钱」越多…

Desc_6.en:
<color=#pinkyellow>While Scholars are not engaged in industrial management or dispatch tasks, they can spontaneously change the <SpName=mousetip_moodlcircular>[Mood] of other characters on the same tile...</color>
 - The higher the Scholar's <SpName=mousetip_qiyuan_1>[Wit], the more characters are affected...
 - The higher the Scholar's Attainment in <SpName=mousetip_jiyi_0>[Music], <SpName=mousetip_jiyi_1>[Weiqi], <SpName=mousetip_jiyi_2>[Literature], or <SpName=mousetip_jiyi_3>[Painting], the more the characters' <SpName=mousetip_moodlcircular>[Mood]</color> changes...
 - The Scholar's mindset determines the effect of [Talent Showcase]: <SpName=mousetip_lichang_0><color=#ffe78f>Principled</color> Scholars likely increase characters' Mood; <SpName=mousetip_lichang_1><color=#9fe0dc>Benevolent</color> Scholars always increase it; <SpName=mousetip_lichang_2><color=#ffffff>Moderate</color> Scholars may randomly increase or decrease it; <SpName=mousetip_lichang_3><color=#b975ff>Rebellious</color> Scholars always decrease it; <SpName=mousetip_lichang_4><color=#c6272e>Egocentric</color> Scholars likely decrease it...
Desc_6.cn:
<color=#pinkyellow>文人未参与产业经营和派遣工作时，可自发改变其所在地格上其他人物的<SpName=mousetip_moodlcircular>「心情」…</color>
 -文人的<SpName=mousetip_qiyuan_1>「聪颖」越高，影响的人数越多…
 -文人的<SpName=mousetip_jiyi_0>「音律」<SpName=mousetip_jiyi_1>「弈棋」<SpName=mousetip_jiyi_2>「诗书」<SpName=mousetip_jiyi_3>「绘画」任一技艺造诣越高，人物的<SpName=mousetip_moodlcircular>「心情」变化得越多…
 -文人的处世立场决定「试才献艺」的效果： <SpName=mousetip_lichang_0><color=#ffe78f>刚正</color>的文人大概率增加人物的心情；<SpName=mousetip_lichang_1><color=#9fe0dc>仁善</color>的文人必然增加人物的心情；<SpName=mousetip_lichang_2><color=#ffffff>中庸</color>的文人随机增加或减少人物的心情；<SpName=mousetip_lichang_3><color=#b975ff>叛逆</color>的文人必然减少人物的心情；<SpName=mousetip_lichang_4><color=#c6272e>唯我</color>的文人大概率减少人物的心情…

Desc_7.en: <color=#pinkyellow>While Mound Wardens are not engaged in industrial management or dispatch tasks, they can spontaneously battle <SpName=mousetip_heterodoxy>[Outlaws] and <SpName=mousetip_rumo>[Xiangshu Underlings] whose Pure Essence does not exceed their own, depositing the spoils in the Treasury...</color>\n - The higher the Mound Warden's <SpName=mousetip_qiyuan_3>[Valor], the more <SpName=mousetip_combat>[battles] they can fight each month...
Desc_7.cn: <color=#pinkyellow>护冢未参与产业经营和派遣工作时，可自发与精纯不高于自己的<SpName=mousetip_heterodoxy>「外道」<SpName=mousetip_rumo>「相枢爪牙」战斗，并将战利品存至公库…</color>\n -护冢的<SpName=mousetip_qiyuan_3>「勇壮」越高，当月可进行<SpName=mousetip_combat>「战斗」的次数越多…

Desc_8.en:
<color=#pinkyellow>Emissaries can spontaneously change the <SpName=mousetip_multilove>[Favorability] and relationships between other characters (excluding the Taiwu Successor) within a 2-tile radius of their current tile...</color>
 - The higher the envoy's <SpName=mousetip_qiyuan_5>[Luck], the more characters are affected...
 - The higher the envoy's <SpName=mousetip_jiyi_4>[Astrology] Attainment, the more <SpName=mousetip_multilove>[Favorability] between characters changes...
 - The envoy's mindset determines the effect of [Social Savvy]: <SpName=mousetip_lichang_0><color=#ffe78f>Principled</color> envoys likely increase Favorability between characters; <SpName=mousetip_lichang_1><color=#9fe0dc>Benevolent</color> envoys always increase it; <SpName=mousetip_lichang_2><color=#ffffff>Moderate</color> envoys may randomly increase or decrease it; <SpName=mousetip_lichang_3><color=#b975ff>Rebellious</color> envoys always decrease it; <SpName=mousetip_lichang_4><color=#c6272e>Egocentric</color> envoys likely decrease it...
Desc_8.cn:
<color=#pinkyellow>使者可自发改变其所在地格2格范围内，其他人物（太吾传人除外）之间的<SpName=mousetip_multilove>「好感」及关系…</color>
 -使者的<SpName=mousetip_qiyuan_5>「福缘」越高，影响的人物越多…
 -使者的<SpName=mousetip_jiyi_4>「术数」造诣越高，人物之间的<SpName=mousetip_multilove>「好感」变化得越多…
 -使者的处世立场决定「人情世故」的效果：<SpName=mousetip_lichang_0><color=#ffe78f>刚正</color>的使者大概率增加人物之间的好感；<SpName=mousetip_lichang_1><color=#9fe0dc>仁善</color>的使者必然增加人物之间的好感；<SpName=mousetip_lichang_2><color=#ffffff>中庸</color>的使者随机增加或减少人物之间的好感；<SpName=mousetip_lichang_3><color=#b975ff>叛逆</color>的使者必然减少人物之间的好感；<SpName=mousetip_lichang_4><color=#c6272e>唯我</color>的使者大概率减少人物之间的好感…

Desc_9.en: <color=#pinkyellow>During each Month Advance, there is a chance for the envoy to perform an additional [Social Savvy]...</color>\n - The higher the envoy's <SpName=mousetip_qiyuan_5>[Luck], the higher the chance of this additional performance...
Desc_9.cn: <color=#pinkyellow>每次月份更替时，使者有概率额外进行一次「人情世故」…</color>\n-使者的<SpName=mousetip_qiyuan_5>「福缘」越高，额外进行的概率越高…

 -文人的处世立场决定「试才献艺」的效果： <SpName=mousetip_lichang_0><color=#ffe78f>刚正</color>的文人大概率增加人物的心情；<SpName=mousetip_lichang_1><color=#9fe0dc>仁善</color>的文人必然增加人物的心情；<SpName=mousetip_lichang_2><color=#ffffff>中庸</color>的文人随机增加或减少人物的心情；<SpName=mousetip_lichang_3><color=#b975ff>叛逆</color>的文人必然减少人物的心情；<SpName=mousetip_lichang_4><color=#c6272e>唯我</color>的文人大概率减少人物的心情…

DescContent_7.en: <color=#pinkyellow>Righteous Deed: While Mound Wardens are not engaged in industrial management or dispatch tasks, they can spontaneously battle <SpName=mousetip_heterodoxy>[Outlaws] and <SpName=mousetip_rumo>[Xiangshu Underlings] whose Pure Essence does not exceed their own, depositing the spoils in the Treasury...</color>\n - The higher the Mound Warden's <SpName=mousetip_qiyuan_3>[Valor], the more <SpName=mousetip_combat>[battles] they can fight each month...
DescContent_7.cn: <color=#pinkyellow>行侠仗义：护冢未参与产业经营和派遣工作时，可自发与精纯不高于自己的<SpName=mousetip_heterodoxy>「外道」<SpName=mousetip_rumo>「相枢爪牙」战斗，并将战利品存至公库…</color>\n -护冢的<SpName=mousetip_qiyuan_3>「勇壮」越高，当月可进行<SpName=mousetip_combat>「战斗」的次数越多…

DescContent_8.en:
<color=#pinkyellow>Social Savvy: Emissaries can spontaneously change the <SpName=mousetip_multilove>[Favorability] and relationships between other characters (excluding the Taiwu Successor) within a 2-tile radius of their current tile...</color>
 - The higher the envoy's <SpName=mousetip_qiyuan_5>[Luck], the more characters are affected...
 - The higher the envoy's <SpName=mousetip_jiyi_4>[Astrology] Attainment, the more <SpName=mousetip_multilove>[Favorability] between characters changes...
 - The envoy's mindset determines the effect of [Social Savvy]: <SpName=mousetip_lichang_0><color=#ffe78f>Principled</color> envoys likely increase Favorability between characters; <SpName=mousetip_lichang_1><color=#9fe0dc>Benevolent</color> envoys always increase it; <SpName=mousetip_lichang_2><color=#ffffff>Moderate</color> envoys may randomly increase or decrease it; <SpName=mousetip_lichang_3><color=#b975ff>Rebellious</color> envoys always decrease it; <SpName=mousetip_lichang_4><color=#c6272e>Egocentric</color> envoys likely decrease it...
DescContent_8.cn:
<color=#pinkyellow>人情世故：使者可自发改变其所在地格2格范围内，其他人物（太吾传人除外）之间的<SpName=mousetip_multilove>「好感」及关系…</color>
 -使者的<SpName=mousetip_qiyuan_5>「福缘」越高，影响的人物越多…
 -使者的<SpName=mousetip_jiyi_4>「术数」造诣越高，人物之间的<SpName=mousetip_multilove>「好感」变化得越多…
 -使者的处世立场决定「人情世故」的效果：<SpName=mousetip_lichang_0><color=#ffe78f>刚正</color>的使者大概率增加人物之间的好感；<SpName=mousetip_lichang_1><color=#9fe0dc>仁善</color>的使者必然增加人物之间的好感；<SpName=mousetip_lichang_2><color=#ffffff>中庸</color>的使者随机增加或减少人物之间的好感；<SpName=mousetip_lichang_3><color=#b975ff>叛逆</color>的使者必然减少人物之间的好感；<SpName=mousetip_lichang_4><color=#c6272e>唯我</color>的使者大概率减少人物之间的好感…

DescContent_9.en: <color=#pinkyellow>Karmic Chance: During each Month Advance, there is a chance for the envoy to perform an additional [Social Savvy]...</color>\n - The higher the envoy's <SpName=mousetip_qiyuan_5>[Luck], the higher the chance of this additional performance...
DescContent_9.cn: <color=#pinkyellow>缘来如此：每次月份更替时，使者有概率额外进行一次「人情世故」…</color>\n-使者的<SpName=mousetip_qiyuan_5>「福缘」越高，额外进行的概率越高…
